name: hds-mcp
description: Read and add to your Health Data Safe account, and import your own medical records from files on this computer.
long_description: Health Data Safe (HDS) tools for your AI assistant: look up the HDS data model, read your account, add data, and import a package of your own medical records from files on this computer after you review it on a local page. Signs in through your browser; nothing is stored on disk but the import's own files. Connects to the HDS demo platform unless you ask for production.
